concerns.text: The split is family-held-out (no family spans splits), yet eval_runner writes 'intra- vs inter-family comparison' with intra_family_mape. On a test set composed entirely of unseen families there are, by construction, no intra-family test points relative to training; intra-family MAPE is either undefined or silently computed within test families, which measures something else. Define what intra-family means here (e.g., within-test-family variance, or a secondary random split) or drop the metric.

Two non-identical family definitions coexist: 'family = space group + cation-anion stoichiometry class' (spec SC-002) and 'StructureMatcher clustering' (T013f). If StructureMatcher merges structures across space groups, the leakage guarantee validated by splitter.py may not match the family definition the success criteria are stated over. Pick one definition as the split unit and state that StructureMatcher (if retained) is subordinate to it.
